# Contact Karbon

Our support and sales teams are available to answer any questions you have. If you're an existing customer, in-app support is also available in the help and feedback section of Karbon.

### Contact Support

To speak to the support team, use the following phone numbers

- US: [+1 415 592 6352](tel:+1 415 592 6352)
- AU: [+61 27 908 7702](tel:+61 27 908 7702)
- UK: [+44 20 4600 6764](tel:+44 20 4600 6764)

Phone support is available 24 hours, 7 days a week.

### Contact Sales

Start a chat to connect with the Sales team

Contact Sales
